protocolAssessment.schema: Exact required 13 fields, schemaVersion integer 1, stage pre_push, guardPass boolean true, imageMeasure docker.image.Size
protocolAssessment.order: All 12 qualification gates including image build/smoke, then image inspect/positive accepted size, then receipt, then ECR authentication/login/push. Failures before receipt cannot publish.
protocolAssessment.counting: Child stdout and stderr drain separately under one shared cap; receipt includes its own full prefixed line/newline in stdoutBytes; whole record capacity is checked before emission; secret capture is separately bounded across both streams and emits no credential bytes.
protocolAssessment.identity: Existing environment names preserved; source/version/repository/region/execution/build/deadline checked before gates. Shipping must compare receipt identities/limits with submission record.
protocolAssessment.limits: Receipt maximum 4096 bytes. Counts exclude platform/bootstrap/daemon logs and separately bounded failure footer. Pre-push snapshot proves neither completed push nor cloud termination/cost cap.
